responsibility: Provides the C-family front-end integration hook `TARGET_CPU_CPP_BUILTINS` for RISC-V. Its job is to publish preprocessor macros that describe the selected ISA, ABI, code model, XLEN/FLEN, floating-point mode, compressed/atomic/mul/div support, and individual `-march` extension versions by walking the parsed `riscv_subset_list`, so C and C++ source can conditionally compile against the exact target configuration.
